desc: Made in America, Talley Manufacturing's RMR Mounts are machined entirely from high grade 6000 series alloy and protected with a black anodized finish ensuring the craftsmanship of these Direct RMR Mounts last the lifetime of your firearm. The Marlin Lever Action RMR Mounts are all designed and manufactured with precision to fit your shotgun with the industry's tightest manufacturing tolerances. These RMR Direct mounts provide a mounting platform for RMR foot print Red Dot optics eliminating the need for a picatinny rail or other adapters for your specified firearm. Whether you are looking for to upgrade your favorite turkey gun or tactical shotgun, this RMR Mount offers a light weight minimized mounting solution for RMR Foot print optics.
